subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider?
rationale: The source confirms stale visible copy, but the issue's requested wording is not the exact official wording found in current Google pages, and provider-id changes would affect compatibility.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update only labels/help/docs to a current Google-aligned name while keeping the stable `google-vertex` provider id.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Adopt the reporter's wording even though the official pages checked during review did not show that exact phrase.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI
options.body: Leave the UI/docs unchanged until maintainers decide Google’s rebrand should be reflected in OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update only labels/help/docs to a current Google-aligned name while keeping the stable `google-vertex` provider id.

likelyOwner.reason: This login has the strongest recent ownership signal for provider onboarding metadata and was explicitly asked for the label decision in the issue discussion.
